seo.title: Contact {name} — 24/7 Restoration Dispatch
seo.description: Call {phone} or email {email}. Ona Restoration dispatches 24/7 across Vancouver, WA and the Portland metro.

hero.title: Get in touch with dispatch.
hero.body: Emergency? Pick up the phone — a real technician answers. Not urgent? Send a few photos by email and we'll come back with a preliminary scope.

phoneCard.note: Tap to call. Live answer, day or night.

emailCard.note: Attach photos and your address. We reply within the hour during business hours, same morning otherwise.

afterCall.title: What happens after you call
afterCall.body: For emergencies we run a clean, fast playbook. Most callers are on-site with a crew inside the hour.

steps.title: Live answer
steps.text: A real technician picks up — day or night. We confirm your address and the loss in under two minutes.

steps.title: Dispatch
steps.text: Closest available crew is on the road within minutes. We text you the technician's name and ETA.

steps.title: On-site
steps.text: Target 60 minutes anywhere in the Portland metro. We stop the damage spreading before anything else.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.text: Photos, moisture readings and Xactimate-formatted scope go to your insurance adjuster the same day.
